arrival: Uzbekistan lander Zero One, powered descent. Brakes firing. Touchdown. The capsule is your first shelter. Walk back up the ramp to refill oxygen.
surface: Move with W, A, S, D. Hold left click to mine, and hold Shift to run. The visor shows food, water, and oxygen. Press Q to use a selected supply.
mission: Press C to craft or B to build. Power your drill with a turbine. Press P to allocate electricity to food, shielding, and an Earth radio with a signal delay.
weather: Dust storm. Solar output is dropping. Switch to backup power. Solar radiation is a separate danger. Get inside and power your shielding.
plans: This is one possible future for this valley. Pressure builds. Blue haze appears. Water collects and rain falls. Plants take root. Use M for the survey map and J for mission objectives.
dust_warning: Dust storm approaching. Solar panels will make less power. Check your grid and keep a backup source.
solar_warning: Solar storm. Get indoors. Power your shielding at outpost control.
step_0: Move with W, A, S, and D. Find three iron deposits. Aim at each one and hold left click until it breaks.
step_1: Find two blue cobalt deposits. Press C and craft an oxygen capsule. Select a capsule with one, then press Q when you need air.
step_2: Press B and choose a wind turbine. Close the build menu by selecting the blueprint, then left click on clear ground to place it.
step_3: Now build a tier one pressure drill. Check that the turbine is supplying enough power. Watch for the terraformation index to rise.
step_4: Build a habitat and snap a door to one of its walls. Step inside. Your oxygen will refill in the shelter.
step_5: Follow the seed cache marker and press E to open it. Build a vegetube, power it, and use E to install a seed.
step_6: Build a solar array for more power. At one hundred T I, you can build a heater. Search the survey caches or the highlands for iridium.
step_7: Keep the grid running to reach Blue Haze at four hundred T I. Press H to check output or press E on a machine to see its power status.
step_8: Keep terraformers powered. The Silent Basin fills at nine hundred T I. Add grass spreaders at eighteen hundred. Living Planet is reached at thirty-five hundred.
low_air: Oxygen is low. Return to a shelter or use an oxygen capsule.
low_water: Hydration is low. Use a water bottle.
low_food: Nutrition is low. Use a food pack.
salvage_start: Dust front approaching. Pack oxygen and follow your waypoint to the South Freight Wreck. Recover a circuit board and bring it back to the landing pod.
salvage_return: Circuit board recovered. Return to the landing pod. Open outpost control to connect the storm reserve.
salvage_trial: Reserve connected. Watch what your power choice keeps running. The systems you left off must wait.
salvage_done: Reserve trial complete. The journal shows what your decision kept running.
